Logged a new technique tonight — "Throw Stall". The game is deeper than anyone playing it, which is the most reassuring thought I know.
Took Weekly. The bracket played out almost exactly as mapped — almost. The 'almost' goes in the notes.
BufferKing's habits are a curriculum and I have enrolled. The series will show who studies harder.

The FrameOne series has become its own subject. I keep a page just for them now. Iron sharpens iron — and I brought a whetstone.
Breakthrough. The flaw was adaptation; the evidence was months of it — another loss their character had answers for. Closed the gap today. Log updated.

narration: Bellwether cracks their knuckles as TiltProof picks their character.
Character select locks in. Round one.
Bellwether gets in behind Glass Garden — +2 on block — and simply does not leave.
Bellwether resets the pressure. 127 more off the top, and TiltProof still hasn't had a turn.
TiltProof tries to escape and finds the exit is also covered.
Bellwether touches with Jumping Arc — it confirms. 113.
— Glass Garden keeps it rolling: 91.
— Standing Jab keeps it rolling: 74.
— and Throw CLOSES it. 56 to finish — 334 off one touch.
Low. Sweep catches TiltProof standing for 356.
TiltProof is DIZZY — stars over their head, arms down, and Bellwether has all the time in the world.
The jab war goes to Bellwether — their Standing Jab is 4f to TiltProof's 7f, and a frame is a frame: 132.
Bellwether doesn't reach for anything fancy — a 4f Standing Jab for 51 is all that's left to do, to bank game one.
They run it back. Game 2.
Bellwether tangles TiltProof up in Glass Garden — 299.
Bellwether holds the block on Skyward Guard, sees -10, and makes TiltProof pay 350 for it.
The overhead. Jumping Arc comes down over the guard for 224 — Bellwether guessed high when it mattered.
A clean touch for TiltProof, but the hands don't answer — 104 and back to neutral.
Bellwether touches with Quick Poke — it confirms. 195.
— and Curtain Call CLOSES it. 156 to finish — 351 off one touch.
A clean 2–0 sweep. Bellwether never looked worried.
